title: Veronica Montebello
html:
Veronica Montebello is a visiting senior lecturer and clinical supervisor at the University of Malta within the Faculties of Dental Surgery and Health Sciences. A Senior Fellow of the UK Higher Education Academy and a registered dental hygienist, she has extensive experience in both public and private healthcare in Malta.

She has contributed significantly to curriculum design, programme development, and healthcare workforce planning, including work on Malta’s National Health Workforce Strategy (2020–2030) through her role within the Ministry for Health. Currently serving as Lead Profession Manager of Dental Hygiene Services in Malta, Veronica is actively involved in European and international initiatives on workforce planning and forecasting, including projects with the WHO and the EU HEROES Joint Action. She is the founder and former president of the Malta Association of Dental Hygiene and currently serves as Treasurer of the EDHF. She also contributes to the review of the Common Education Curriculum for European Dental Hygienists.

Veronica served on the regulatory body, the Council for the Professions Complementary to Medicine and, since 2016, has worked extensively in quality assurance and accreditation as an expert reviewer and chairperson for External Quality Assurance audits and programme accreditation for the Malta Further and Higher Education Authority.
